name: Islam Dulatov
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: A German welterweight (12-1, age 28) from Triple One Gym, signed off the 2024 Contender Series. He knocked out Adam Fugitt in R1 in his UFC debut in July 2025; a July 2026 bout with Wellington Turman was cancelled when he fell ill.

how_they_fight.Striking: A finisher: seven knockouts and five submissions in our data, eleven of the twelve in R1.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Five R1 submissions, most of them very fast (under a minute).
how_they_fight.Defense: Only loss a decision; never stopped.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Patient enough to set up a left hook (Fugitt).

patterns: Finishes in R1 by strikes or submission

news.text: Booked against Levan Chokheli after his July bout with Wellington Turman was cancelled because he fell ill.
